answer.summary: Monday.com saw strong feedback on its AI actions but very low adoption: only a few thousand accounts used them out of 250,000 paying companies. The rollout mistake was leaving access gated while a terms-of-service change was deferred; the team recognized that broader access was the highest-impact fix and decided to open the actions to everyone immediately.

sections.heading: What went wrong—and how they corrected it
sections.content: Daily usage numbers showed that only a few thousand accounts were using the AI actions, despite positive customer feedback and 250,000 paying companies overall. The team learned that customers needed a terms-of-service change before the AI actions could be opened to them, but that change had been planned for the next quarter. They called out the delay and decided to make the change then, opening the AI actions to everyone rather than waiting. The mistake was treating encouraging feedback as sufficient while access remained restricted; their correction was to remove that access bottleneck promptly.
